subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay bounded media from unmentioned group messages for later mentioned turns, and what limits should apply to media kind, TTL, local-path exposure, and group visibility?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the repair changes how bystander group attachments can enter later model context, so automation should not choose that privacy/security boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded local image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep Text-Only History
options.body: Document that unmentioned Telegram media is not replayed from group history unless the current turn includes the attachment, avoiding new media-retention exposure.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a proposed PR demonstrates the exact Telegram failure and bounded retention behavior with redacted live proof.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded local image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-history signal across the Telegram context split and shared history-media contract that a bounded fix should reuse.
